vc_checking.summary: All three manual VCs are semantically valid. They share one middle-node xizi_dll/xizi_dllseg decomposition and recomposition family; the two return branches derive the case-specific value from whether the suffix starts at the sentinel.

vc_shape.pre_pure: linklist_pre = head, linklist_node_pre = node, and linklist_node_pre <> 0
vc_shape.pre_exists: xizi_dll hides sentinel first/last and dllseg hides internal next pointers
vc_shape.post_spatial: sentinel next/prev fields, prefix xizi_dllseg ending at node, node next/prev fields, and suffix xizi_dllseg ending at head
vc_shape.post_exists: first and last from opening xizi_dll; node_prev and node_next from the middle split

witnesses.witness_instantiation: Select the closed-list first disjunct. Open xizi_dll, induct over nodes_before in its segment, and instantiate first/last from the sentinel plus node_prev/node_next at the distinguished node boundary.
witnesses.space_plan: Apply a proved middle-split helper to the precondition xizi_dll, unfold xizi_dll_links/XiziDLL.links at the generated boundary, and cancel the exact sentinel, prefix, node, and suffix resources.
witnesses.pure_plan: Rewrite PreH1 and PreH2. PreH3 supplies node <> NULL; each nonempty dllseg constructor supplies its head equality, non-nullness, and inequality from the stop. Only list app simplification is needed.
premise_discharge: node <> NULL is PreH3 after linklist_node_pre = node and NULL/0 normalization.
All post resources partition the single precondition xizi_dll; no ownership is invented.
witnesses.failure_signal: None; inability to perform the inductive split would be proof engineering, not a semantic annotation gap.
witnesses.grouping_reason: Forward half of the same middle-node transformation used in reverse by both return witnesses.

vc_shape.pre_spatial: sentinel fields ** prefix segment to node ** node fields with node_next ** suffix segment from node_next to head
vc_shape.pre_pure: node_next = head, linklist_pre = head, linklist_node_pre = node, and linklist_node_pre <> 0
vc_shape.pre_exists: none; all structural endpoints are named parameters
vc_shape.post_spatial: the unchanged xizi_dll head (nodes_before ++ node :: nodes_after), choosing the first post disjunct
vc_shape.post_exists: xizi_dll hides the reused first and last endpoints

witnesses.witness_instantiation: Select the first disjunct and reuse first/last when closing xizi_dll. Substituting node_next=head makes the suffix a same-start/stop segment, hence nodes_after=nil.
witnesses.space_plan: Fold each field pair to xizi_dll_links, apply the middle recomposition helper to prefix, distinguished node, and suffix, and close with the unchanged sentinel links.
witnesses.pure_plan: Destruct nodes_after after substituting PreH1. The cons case contradicts the dllseg guard node_next <> stop; the nil case reduces xizi_double_link_next_value nil to 0. No arithmetic is needed.
premise_discharge: nodes_after=nil follows from node_next=head and the suffix dllseg definition.
The recomposition helper consumes exactly the resources already present in P; any node=head alias case is inconsistent with separated duplicate field ownership.
witnesses.failure_signal: None; the sentinel equality semantically forces an empty logical suffix.
witnesses.grouping_reason: Uses the shared recomposition helper and the nil-suffix specialization of the same value definition.

vc_shape.pre_spatial: sentinel fields ** prefix segment to node ** node fields with node_next ** non-sentinel suffix segment from node_next to head
vc_shape.pre_pure: node_next <> head, linklist_pre = head, linklist_node_pre = node, and linklist_node_pre <> 0
vc_shape.pre_exists: the suffix's next pointer and rest list are hidden until xizi_dllseg_unfold
vc_shape.post_spatial: the unchanged xizi_dll head (nodes_before ++ node :: nodes_after), choosing the first post disjunct
vc_shape.post_exists: xizi_dll hides the reused first and last endpoints

witnesses.witness_instantiation: Use node_next <> head with xizi_dllseg_unfold to obtain a rest list and nodes_after = node_next :: rest; reuse all endpoints for recomposition.
witnesses.space_plan: Expose the suffix only as needed to obtain its logical head, retain/fold the same suffix ownership, apply the shared middle recomposition helper, and close xizi_dll with sentinel links.
witnesses.pure_plan: PreH1 discharges the stop-inequality premise of xizi_dllseg_unfold. Its equality nodes_after=node_next::rest reduces xizi_double_link_next_value to node_next by simplification; no arithmetic is needed.
premise_discharge: node_next <> head is exactly PreH1 and justifies suffix unfolding.
The unfolded node links/rest segment are the original suffix resource and can be folded back before recomposition.
witnesses.failure_signal: None; the non-sentinel guard and dllseg definition force node_next to be the first element of nodes_after.
witnesses.grouping_reason: Uses the same recomposition helper as return_wit_1, with the nonempty-suffix branch of the value definition.

analysis_groups.shared_proof_pattern: Expose or rebuild the same circular doubly linked list at one distinguished middle node.
analysis_groups.shared_space_plan: Use one proved group-suffixed split/recompose helper family over xizi_dll_links and xizi_dllseg, unfolding link pairs only at generated-VC boundaries.
analysis_groups.shared_pure_plan: Use node <> NULL for splitting, node_next=head to force an empty suffix, and node_next<>head plus xizi_dllseg_unfold to force a suffix headed by node_next.
analysis_groups.grouping_reason: One function, one inverse segment transformation, and one helper family cover all three targets; 3 <= 12, so a single group is minimal and policy-compliant.

proof_groups.proof_strategy: Prove group-suffixed split/recompose helpers by induction on nodes_before; split entail_wit_1, derive nil and simplify for return_wit_1, derive node_next::rest and simplify for return_wit_2, then recompose unchanged ownership.
proof_groups.grouping_reason: All three witnesses share one function, one xizi_dll/xizi_dllseg middle-node boundary, and one helper family; group size 3 is within the maximum 12.
